messages:
tara_cs: heads-up — acme reported a flood of embedding rejects after we switched their project to the new quantized-3 model and ran a backfill overnight. customer seeing ~30% rejects from our indexer. ticket ACME-4871.

alexa_support: ugh. can you paste the indexer error and a sample request id?

tara_cs: sure. here's the most common indexer log line from last 30m:
```
ERROR indexer/insert.go:142 id=acme-12345 batch=987 reason=dim_mismatch expected=1536 got=1024
```
and a sample request payload (sanitized):
```json
{"request_id":"r-9f2a","model":"quantized-3","embedding": [0.001, 0.12, ..., 0.004] /* length 1024 */}
```

indexer_bot: alert: vector-ingest rejects increased 5.6x over baseline for project acme. top error: dim_mismatch (expected 1536, got 1024). backfill job id bf-2026-03-16 still running.

alexa_support: do we know why the model dim changed? was that expected during the migration?

mikhail_eng: quick context — quantized-3 was onboarded as a low-cost 1024-dim variant for some customers. acme's vecdb schema still expects 1536 (legacy prod model). there should have been a compatibility check earlier in rollout. looks like the backfill didn't gate by schema.

eng_oncall_ryan: oncall taking. immediate mitigations: 1) pause backfill job bf-2026-03-16; 2) add a temporary request-side check to drop inputs with wrong dim and route to fallback model (old-1536); 3) mark rejects as non-billable for acme until resolved.

tara_cs: done step 1 (stopped the backfill). customer grateful but anxious about data loss. they asked for repro steps so they can confirm on their side.

mikhail_eng: repro checklist for eng/debug: 
1) curl to embeddings endpoint (hosted) with model=quantized-3 and a payload that returns 1024-dim emb. example:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"test","model":"quantized-3"}' | jq '.data[0].embedding | length'
```
2) attempt index insert to vecdb staging using same project schema: expect `dim_mismatch` from indexer.
3) inspect backfill worker logs: `/var/log/backfills/bf-2026-03-16/*.log` for mapping of model->schema used.

alexa_support: thanks. any fast fixes we can offer the customer besides rollback?

mikhail_eng: options short-term: 
- rollback routing for acme to old-1536 model (fast, safe)
- run an adapter transform during backfill that upsamples 1024->1536 by zero-padding or learned projection (padding is quick but changes embedding geometry; warn customer)
- re-run backfill with a migration plan that converts all new embeddings to the vecdb expected dim before insert.

ryan_platform: i'll coordinate rollback if acme approves — low-risk and quickest. patch plan for adapter: we can hotfix a transform in the backfill pipeline. I'll need ~3 hours to get a scoped adapter that zero-pads to 1536 and flags those docs in metadata. not ideal long-term.

tara_cs: ACME prefers rollback + re-run backfill with conversion. they've asked that we not bill them for the failed inserts.

billing_bot: noted. creating billing hold: BILL-HOLD-ACME-2146. rejects and backfill failures from 2146000800-2146004000 marked non-billable pending resolution.

eng_oncall_ryan: action items: 
- ryan_platform: run rollback to old-1536 at 2146004200 unless customer needs delay.
- mikhail_eng: prepare adapter for backfill conversion and a test plan (staging repro + integrity checks).
- tara_cs: get acme sign-off for rollback window and confirm they want a clean re-run.
- alexa_support: draft customer-facing note explaining cause/mitigation and non-billable status.

mikhail_eng: test notes for adapter: 
- transform logic: if len(emb)==1024 -> emb = emb + [0.0]*(1536-1024); tag `_converted_dim: true`.
- run 1k doc dry-run against staging vecdb to measure drift in nearest-neighbor recall vs original 1536 embeddings; include eval report.
- if recall drop > 5% we escalate to research for a projection-based converter.

tara_cs: acme confirmed rollback window at 2146004200 UTC. please keep them updated.

alexa_support: ping when rollback done and when backfill adapter is ready so cs can verify. :thumbsup:

eng_oncall_ryan: rolled back routing at 2146004250 — verified traffic to old-1536 model for project acme. indexer rejects dropped to baseline.

mikhail_eng: started building the zero-pad adapter; pushing staging branch pr/458. will run unit + e2e. ETA 2.5h.

tara_cs: acme confirmed they see no more rejects and appreciate the quick action. closing urgent customer impact. will follow up about re-run timeline.

alexa_support: great work team. postmortem action: add a rollout gate that verifies project vecdb schema dims before enabling model variant migrations. filing followup ticket: INFRA-embed-migration-gate.

indexer_bot: resolved alert: reject rate returned to normal for acme.

billing_bot: billing hold closed after credit applied to account. reference BILL-CREDIT-ACME-2146.

mikhail_eng: note: long-term we should add a schema-aware model catalog flag (eg. "embedding_dim":1536) and a preflight check during model assignment. leaving that for INFRA-embed-migration-gate.

tara_cs: thanks all. closing thread, will add ACME-4871 notes to ticketing system. :white_check_mark:
